TNIC All Pages Embeds — Master Reference

Every HTML embed block for the True Nation Intranet, organized by page.
Copy any embed, paste it into Google Sites via Insert → Embed → Embed Code.

How to use: Find your section below → click Copy HTML → Google Sites → Insert → Embed → Embed Code → paste → Next → Insert. Then drag the bottom edge of the embed block down until all content is visible with no scrollbar.

tnic-brand-styles.html

Brand Stylesheet (Global)

Global CSS embed defining brand tokens (colors, fonts, spacing), card/button/badge classes, and mobile-first responsive rules. Place this embed at the top of EVERY Google Sites page — it is invisible but its styles cascade to all content below.

My Dashboard

4 embeds
dashboard-identity.html

Identity Card

LIVE DATA — Wine gradient card showing the logged-in user's real name, department, branch, and campus via Apps Script (?widget=identity). Time-of-day greeting uses the user's local time. Place at the TOP of the My Dashboard page — no native Sites heading needed. Requires profile-editor.gs to be deployed.

👁 Preview (sample data — live version shows real user data)
dashboard-quick-actions.html

Quick Actions

Two-tile action grid: Submit Announcement + Submit Request (both placeholders). Add native Sites heading "QUICK ACTIONS" above this embed. [REPLACE] href values with actual Google Form URLs when processes are built.

👁 Preview
dashboard-my-profile.html

My Profile

TNIC-branded wrapper that embeds the profile-editor.gs standalone Apps Script web app. Place BELOW the Upcoming Events section on My Dashboard. Add native Sites heading "MY PROFILE" above this embed.

👁 Preview
dashboard-my-department.html

My Department

LIVE DATA — Card showing the logged-in user's real department name, title/role, and branch via Apps Script (?widget=department). Department icon auto-mapped by name. Add native Sites heading "MY DEPARTMENT" above this embed. Requires profile-editor.gs to be deployed.

👁 Preview (sample data — live version shows real user data)
dashboard-events.html

Upcoming Events

Event list with date boxes, filtered by user's campus. Add native Sites heading "UPCOMING EVENTS" above this embed. Data sourced from Google Calendar feed.
